Sri Panwa Lagoon

Villa in Bang Tao
HomeNew ProjectsSri Panwa Lagoon

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

Lakefront residences within a 60-rai mixed-use development in Bang Tao, comprising 16 pool villas and 12 Multi-Flex houses delivered as customisable shells. Architecture is by Habita Architects with interiors by Studio Chemistri, and the project is limited to 28 homes.

Facilities & amenities

  • 24/7 security
  • CCTV
  • Covered parking
  • Fitness center
  • Landscaped gardens
  • Swimming pool
  • Rooftop terrace
  • Multi-purpose clubhouse
  • Baba Lake Club (fitness, lap pools, hydrotherapy, lounges)
  • Food and beverage complex

Frequently asked questions

Where is Sri Panwa Lagoon?

Sri Panwa Lagoon is a pool villa and multi-flex house project in Bang Tao, Phuket, developed by Charn Issara.

What is the starting price of Sri Panwa Lagoon?

The advertised starting price is ฿41,000,000, last checked 2026-11-12. Prices and availability change, so ask us on WhatsApp for the current figures.

What ownership is offered at Sri Panwa Lagoon?

Sources list freehold and leasehold ownership. Always confirm the exact title and conditions with a Thai lawyer before buying; this is general information, not legal advice.

When will Sri Panwa Lagoon be ready?

Current status: under construction. Dates can change, so please confirm with us.
